name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2025-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.98 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
